content.executive_summary:
- **Engineering Manager Verified**: AvantGarde Foundry posting offers **$100K-$140K** fully remote U.S. role requiring Python, React, TypeScript/JavaScript - directly satisfies all constraints with a company-career-page application URL.
- **Frontend Developer Verified**: Close (via Ashby) posts a **$140K-$210K** 100% remote senior frontend/React role with React, JavaScript, and TypeScript as core requirements - highest salary among all verified postings.
- **Founding Engineer Partially Verified**: Rover AI on Indeed lists a remote-worldwide founding engineer role requiring TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and Python, but salary is stated only as "competitive" without a figure - does not meet the "$80K stated clearly" constraint.
- **Backend Developer Partially Verified**: JS Consulting via ZipRecruiter lists a 100% remote staff backend engineer role with Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, and React, but no salary figure is published - same salary-verification gap.
- **UI Architect Gap**: Broad LinkedIn and aggregator searches returned category pages (2,000+ React UI Architect jobs on LinkedIn) but no individual verified posting with stated salary and confirmed active status could be extracted within research budget.
- **Node.js Developer Gap**: Indeed returned 411 TypeScript/Node developer remote listings and Jooble showed May 2026 Node.js remote jobs with React.js/TypeScript requirements, but no single posting with a verified $80K+ salary figure and direct apply URL was extracted.
- **Python Developer Gap**: Indeed listed 12 React/JavaScript/TypeScript/Python remote roles; Turing.com advertises remote TypeScript/Python developer positions, but no individual posting with stated salary was fully verified.
- **Engineering Team Lead Partially Verified**: Capital One lists a Senior Lead Software Engineer (Python, React) role posted March 3, 2026 on its official careers page, likely exceeding $80K for a senior lead at a major bank, but exact salary was not extracted in time.
- **Salary Transparency Barrier**: The single biggest constraint-verification challenge across all roles is that many job postings - especially on LinkedIn and Indeed - do not publish salary ranges, even when actual compensation likely exceeds $80K.
- **Remote Dominance**: Every verified or partially verified posting offers remote or hybrid work, confirming that the target tech stack (React/Node/Python/TypeScript) is heavily concentrated in remote-friendly roles in 2026.
